h.gu: Solve કરતાં પહેલાં Single-phase Elementsનું Classification

body.en:
Understand the idea

A pure R,LorCis an ideal model.Real coils/capacitors include losses and parasitic effects.

Explanation and application

  • Rconverts energy into heat;Lstores magnetic energy;Cstores electric-field energy.Stored energy may return to the source during part of a cycle.
  • Use sinusoidal steady state at stated fwith ideal linear components unless specified otherwise.DCand switching transients need a different analysis.
  • For all waveforms here v=Vm sinθand i=Im sin(θ−φ),where φ=angleV−angleI.Positive φmeans current lags;negative φmeans current leads.
Pure Lphase relation?

Voltage leads current90°;Z=jωL;ideal average real power is0but reactive power is positive.

PureR,LકેCidealmodelછે.Realcoil/capacitorમાંlosses/parasiticsહોય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Renergyનેheatમાંફેરવે;LmagneticઅનેCelectric-fieldenergyસંગ્રહે છે.Cycleનાકેટલાકભાગમાંenergyસ્રોતમાંપાછીફરીશકે.
  • જણાવેલfપરideal linearcomponentsનુંsinusoidalsteady-stateanalysisલો.DC/switchingtransientsમાટે જુદુંanalysisજોઈએ.
  • અહીંv=Vm sinθ,i=Im sin(θ−φ)તથાφ=angleV−angleIછે.Positiveφમાંcurrentlagઅનેnegativeφમાંleadકરે છે.
Pure Lનું Phase Relation?

body.en:
Understand the idea

For sinusoidal voltage/current,pf=cosφ=P/(VI);it is a ratio,not an angle or a percentage efficiency.

Explanation and application

  • φ=angleV−angleI.Positive φmeans inductive lagging;negative φmeans capacitive leading.Cosφalone cannot distinguish them because cosine is even.
  • At fixed real power and supply voltage,lower pfrequires higher RMScurrent:P=VIpf.This increases I²Rloss and equipment VAloading;it does not mean the load real power vanishes.
  • Unity displacement power factor means current/voltage in phase.AnRLCnetwork can be unity pfat one frequency even though it contains both Land C.
  • For distorted waveforms,true pf=P/(VrmsIrms),whereas cosφdescribes the fundamental displacement factor;do not equate them without sinusoidal assumptions.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Sinusoidalvoltage/currentમાંpf=cosφ=P/(VI)છે.તેratioછે,angleકેefficiencyનહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • φ=angleV−angleIછે.Positiveφમાંinductivelagging;negativeφમાંcapacitiveleading.Cosφએકલોlead/lagઅલગનકરે,કારણકેcosineevenછે.
  • Fixedrealpower/voltageમાંpfઘટતાંRMScurrentવધે:P=VIpfછે.તેથીI²Rloss/VAloadingવધે;loadrealpowerગાયબનથાય.
  • Unitydisplacementpfમાંcurrent/voltageinphaseછે.L/CબંનેહોવાછતાંRLCnetworkએકfrequencyપરunitypfહોઈશકે.
  • Distortedwaveformમાંtruepf=P/(VrmsIrms)છે.Cosφfundamentaldisplacementfactorછે;sinusoidalassumptionવગરબંનેસમાનનમાનો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Complex power is Scomplex=V I*=P+jQwhen RMSphasors and passive load polarity are used.

Explanation and application

  • P=VIcosφWmeasures average energy transfer into dissipation or useful work.Q=VIsinφvarrepresents alternating energy exchange;Q>0inductive,Q<0capacitive.
  • Apparent power|S|=VIVA=√(P²+Q²),not P+Q.P,Qand |S|use different unit names despite sharing base dimensions.
  • For series RLC:P=I²R;Q=I²(XL−XC).Aninductive triangle points upward and a capacitive one downward;|S|remains nonnegative.
  • At equal RMSvoltage,the correct current reference and conjugation are essential:using VIinstead of VI*usually gives a wrong power angle.

RMSphasor/passiveloadpolarityથીScomplex=V I*=P+jQછે.

  • P=VIcosφWએaverageenergytransfer/dissipation/workછે.Q=VIsinφvarએalternatingenergyexchangeછે.Q>0inductive,Q<0capacitive.
  • Apparentpower|S|=VIVA=√(P²+Q²)છે,P+Qનહિ.P,Q/|S|નામાટેunitnamesજુદાંછે.
  • SeriesRLCમાંP=I²R,Q=I²(XL−XC)છે.Inductivetriangleઉપર/ capacitiveનીચેpointકરે;|S|nonnegativeરહે છે.
  • EqualRMSvoltageમાંપણcurrentreference/conjugationજરૂરીછે.VI*નેબદલેVIલેતાંpowerangleખોટોથઈશકે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Series resonance occurs when the net series reactance is zero at the selected frequency.

Explanation and application

  • From Im(Z)=ωL−1/(ωC)=0,ω₀²LC=1,so f₀=1/(2π√LC).The Rvalue includes relevant series loss and is assumed constant for the ideal response curve.
  • At resonance,Z=R,|Z|minimum,I=V/Rmaximum and pf1for a nonzero R.The source reactive power is zero,but both component reactive voltages/currents can be substantial.
  • VL=IXLand VC=IXCare equal in magnitude and opposite in phase,so they cancel in the voltage sum.They are not each zero.
  • Below f₀,the circuit is net capacitive;above f₀,net inductive.Component voltage magnification means source voltage alone cannot establish safe capacitor/coil ratings.
  • Ideal R=0at exact resonance predicts unbounded steady-state current;it is a model singularity,not a physically safe operating point.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Selectedfrequencyપરnetseriesreactancezeroથાયત્યારેseriesresonanceથાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Im(Z)=ωL−1/(ωC)=0થીω₀²LC=1અનેf₀=1/(2π√LC)મળે.Rમાંrelevantserieslossલો;idealcurveમાટેRconstantમાનો.
  • ResonanceમાંZ=R,|Z|minimum,I=V/Rmaximum/pf1છે;Rnonzeroહોવુંજોઈએ.SourceQzeroહોવાછતાંcomponentreactivevoltages/currentમોટાહોઈશકે.
  • VL=IXLતથાVC=IXCમagnitudeમાંસમાન/phaseમાંoppositeહોવાથીsumમાંcancelથાય.બંનેઅલગથીzeroનથી.
  • f₀નીચેનfrequencyમાંnetcapacitive;ઉપરnetinductiveછે.Voltagemagnificationનેકારણેsourcevoltageએકલાથીsafecomponentratingનક્કીનથીથતી.
  • IdealR=0/exactresonanceમાંunboundedsteady-statecurrentનીpredictionmodelનીsingularityછે;physicallysafeoperatingpointનહિ.

Aim and instruments

Measure R-load quantities and test in-phase resistive behaviour.

Instrument selection

  • Use the approved circuit-specific instruments:generator/CROfor waveform work;isolated source,rated load and appropriate ACV/I/real-power instruments for power circuits.Check manual,ranges,leads and component ratings.
  • The source lists mains-rated variacs/banks;these are supervised laboratory resources,not student DIYinstructions.Avariac does not provide isolation.

Connections and model

Approved isolated ACsource→ammeter/current coil→rated resistive load→return.Voltmeter and wattmeter voltage input go across the load per instrument manual.

Procedure

  1. With power isolated,check load resistance,rating,meter terminals and series/parallel connections;choose ranges before energising.
  2. Under instructor control,apply permitted ACvoltage and record V,I,real power Pand frequency;do not infer Pfrom VIwhen verifying the instrument.
  3. Compare V/Iwith R,Pwith VIand I²R,and compute pf=P/(VI)for nonzero V/I.Include load temperature drift.
  4. Keep actual readings,supply condition,instrument ranges and uncertainty separate from the computed expected reference.
  5. On a discrepancy,stop and check de-energised connections,model assumptions and instrument suitability;do not increase voltage to force agreement.
  6. After approved shutdown,verify safe capacitor discharge and leave the trainer in its required state.Report only work genuinely performed.

Expected calculations and interpretation

Ideal R:φ=0,pf1,Q0and P=VI.Acalculated20V RMS,10Ωexample gives I2A,P40W;it is not a component selection instruction.

Safe fault finding

If pfappears above1,stop and check meter scaling,range,voltage measurement location and uncertainty;do not silently clamp the result.

Essential precautions

  • Only qualified-supervised energised power-lab work is intended.Never defeat protective earth,connect ammeters across the supply,short phases or change wiring while energised.
  • Scope grounds may be common and earth-referenced.Use approved differential/isolated measurement equipment where needed;never float a mains scope by removing its earth.

Aim and instruments

Estimate a series-equivalent coil model at a stated frequency/operating point.

Instrument selection

  • Use the approved circuit-specific instruments:generator/CROfor waveform work;isolated source,rated load and appropriate ACV/I/real-power instruments for power circuits.Check manual,ranges,leads and component ratings.
  • The source lists mains-rated variacs/banks;these are supervised laboratory resources,not student DIYinstructions.Avariac does not provide isolation.

Connections and model

Use the approved isolated ACsource with coil current measured in series and coil voltage/real power at its terminals.Measure DCresistance separately with the coil disconnected and discharged.

Procedure

  1. Record full coil rating and a safe nonsaturating test condition chosen by the instructor;measure disconnected winding DCresistance without applying AC.
  2. Apply the approved ACtest and record f,V,I,P;allow only permitted thermal rise and watch current limits.
  3. Compute |Z|=V/I,r_eff=P/I²,XL=√(|Z|²−r_eff²),L=XL/(2πf).Compare r_effwith rDCand explain copper/core/AC-loss differences.
  4. Keep actual readings,supply condition,instrument ranges and uncertainty separate from the computed expected reference.
  5. On a discrepancy,stop and check de-energised connections,model assumptions and instrument suitability;do not increase voltage to force agreement.
  6. After approved shutdown,verify safe capacitor discharge and leave the trainer in its required state.Report only work genuinely performed.

Expected calculations and interpretation

The effective ACresistance includes represented losses at that operating point;it is not automatically the cold DCwinding resistance.

Safe fault finding

If |Z|²−r_eff²is negative,investigate data/ranges/uncertainty or model failure rather than reporting imaginary inductance as a real measurement.

Essential precautions

  • Only qualified-supervised energised power-lab work is intended.Never defeat protective earth,connect ammeters across the supply,short phases or change wiring while energised.

Aim and instruments

Instrument selection

  • The source lists mains-rated variacs/banks;these are supervised laboratory resources,not student DIYinstructions.Avariac does not provide isolation.

Connections and model

Connect the stated rated components in one series loop with current/wattmeter current inputs in series;voltage inputs across the declared load.Use an AC-rated capacitor where required.

Procedure

  1. Inspect de-energised connections,component ratings and winding/internal losses;select permitted source voltage/frequency and current/power ranges.
  2. Under supervision,record supply V,I,P,fand relevant component voltages;phase measurement uses only an approved isolated/differential arrangement.
  3. Compute Zmodel,Rtotal,net X,φand predicted V/I/P;compare pf=P/(VI)with Rtotal/|Z|and report lead/lag separately.

Aim and instruments

Measure R-load quantities and test in-phase resistive behaviour.

Instrument selection

  • Use the approved circuit-specific instruments:generator/CROfor waveform work;isolated source,rated load and appropriate ACV/I/real-power instruments for power circuits.Check manual,ranges,leads and component ratings.
  • The source lists mains-rated variacs/banks;these are supervised laboratory resources,not student DIYinstructions.Avariac does not provide isolation.

Connections and model

Approved isolated ACsource→ammeter/current coil→rated resistive load→return.Voltmeter and wattmeter voltage input go across the load per instrument manual.

Procedure

  1. With power isolated,check load resistance,rating,meter terminals and series/parallel connections;choose ranges before energising.
  2. Under instructor control,apply permitted ACvoltage and record V,I,real power Pand frequency;do not infer Pfrom VIwhen verifying the instrument.

  4. Keep actual readings,supply condition,instrument ranges and uncertainty separate from the computed expected reference.
  5. On a discrepancy,stop and check de-energised connections,model assumptions and instrument suitability;do not increase voltage to force agreement.

Ideal R:φ=0,pf1,Q0and P=VI.Acalculated20V RMS,10Ωexample gives I2A,P40W;it is not a component selection instruction.
